steps: This video shows how subagents keep the main agent's context clean. Your code asks the main agent to use a researcher, then an analyst, to assess risk in the contracts folder. Its allowed tools include Agent.
The main agent delegates the first task through the Agent tool, with subagent type researcher: find the renewal dates.
The researcher works in a fresh, isolated context with no parent history. It greps the contracts folder with its own read tools and finds three files with three dates.
Only the researcher's final message returns, as the tool result: three dates. All its Grep calls stay behind, so the main context stays clean. The memo comes back, not the notebook.
Next, the analyst also starts with a fresh context. It cannot see anything the parent has seen, so whatever it needs must be carried in the brief.
So the parent pastes the three findings into the analyst's brief. The brief is all the analyst sees, and it rates the risk: two high and one low.

The parent merges the two memos into one assessment, in two turns. Subagents isolate the work, so pass context in explicitly and get a summary back. The full walkthrough is in the Gennoor Claude certification course.
